journey.title: Capture an existing routine
journey.purpose: Bring existing meals, recurring foods, and supplements into Nooch with little effort: paste or type what is eaten now, review only material questions, and keep accepted anchors in future weeks.

steps.intent: Save a usual meal with just its name.
Paste a rough routine and review the staged result, keeping unknown quantities unknown.
Set the planning routine, targets, and fixed supplement schedules.
See accepted anchors in the week while flexible slots stay open for suggestions.

claims.statement: Pasted text is preserved and no recipe, brand, serving weight, dose, or target is invented from it.
